text: This report recommends that the name "Wildflower Way" be approved to identify a proposed private street at 4342 Lawrence Avenue East. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Wildflower Way" for the proposed private street at 4342 Lawrence Avenue East. 2. Requested the applicant to pay the costs, estimated to be $250.00, for the fabrication and installation of the street name signage. 3. Requested the owner and successors of the subject lands to maintain, at their own risk, the street name signage installed under Recommendation 2 to this report (February 27, 2019) from the Director, Engineering Support Services, Engineering and Construction Services.
